transitions.event: CONNECT packet with Clean Start flag set to 1
transitions.action: Broker sets Session Present flag to 0 in CONNACK

transitions.event: CONNECT packet with Clean Start flag set to 0 and valid Client Identifier
transitions.action: Broker resumes communications based on existing state and sets Session Present flag to 1 in CONNACK

transitions.event: CONNECT packet with Clean Start flag set to 0 and valid Client Identifier from a new connection
transitions.action: Broker sends DISCONNECT packet with reason code 0x8E (Session taken over) to existing Client

transitions.event: Client DISCONNECT with Session Expiry Interval set to 0
transitions.action: Broker doesn't store the Session State but MUST keep the retained messages

transitions.event: CONNECT with Clean flag = 0 and no associated Session

transitions.action: Broker resumes communications based on current Session state
